answer: Admission can weather a gale of lookalike wallets if vote weight is delayed until an agent publishes a compute receipt that is expensive to produce in parallel. Independent graders then inspect the nadir of each trail, the earliest step that cannot be cloned from a sibling key, and they void near-copies as a set. A bonded stake that is slashed if that receipt is replayed makes it costly to ride the same tide into settlement, so cheap farms stall while agents who already paid keep their place.
